description: Implementation of a test packet writer that simulates packet dropping, reordering, delays, and socket blocking for QUIC protocol testing.

classes.name: WriteUnblockedAlarm
classes.description: Alarm class to unblock socket when simulated as writable.

classes.name: DelayAlarm
classes.description: Alarm class to trigger delayed packet sending.

classes.name: PacketDroppingTestWriter
classes.description: Test packet writer simulating packet drops, delays, reordering, and socket blocking.

methods.name: PacketDroppingTestWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test packet writer with random seed.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the writer with helper, alarm factory, and callback.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Simulates writing a packet with possible drops, delays, reordering, or blocking.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the writer is currently blocked.

methods.name: SetWritable
methods.description: Marks the writer as writable and cancels unblock alarms.

methods.name: ReleaseNextPacket
methods.description: Releases the next delayed packet, possibly reordering.

methods.name: ReleaseOldPackets
methods.description: Releases all packets whose send time has passed.

methods.name: SetDelayAlarm
methods.description: Sets the delay alarm for the next packet.
